description.value: A neighbourhood branch of the Greater Victoria Public Library system located in Oak Bay. The library offers browsing, public computers, and access to a large digital collection including ebooks, streaming, and archival BC newspapers. A quiet indoor rest stop for touring cyclists passing through Oak Bay Village.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (14 spaces, covered) at 21m; rack (covered) at 47m. Total: 14 spaces.
